name: io.github.kant19801201behax5/phoenix-mcp-server
title: Phoenix Zero — Execution Oracle for L2s
description: Before sending a transaction on an L2: PASS/DEGRADED/FAIL for the chosen chain from per-chain measurements (every ~2 s, 2-3 RPC nodes). Free delayed verdict; live data via x402.

tools.name: check_safety_free
tools.description: FREE safety check for an L2 (100 calls/IP/day): safe/unsafe with reason for the chosen chain, delayed ~60 s. Live verdict: paid x402 GET /api/v1/safe.

tools.name: preflight_network_health
tools.description: PASS/DEGRADED/FAIL for the chosen L2 from its own measurements (latency across 2-3 RPC nodes every ~2 s; revert ratio for Base/Arbitrum). Free answer delayed ~60 s; live latency/revert_ratio via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum).
